## 0.2.246

owes: a changed default and a new page — the web panel now lists *Unread* right after *Timeline* (a new page, `/feeds/unread`: the timeline's unread rows whatever *show read* says; the remembered last view may now be `unread`, which an earlier image reads as no view and ignores), and `+ Add` in the switcher is hidden once every phone app of the catalogue (feed, weather, stocks, notes) has a device paired for the signed-in account (it was always shown); the panel's markup and classes are otherwise unchanged, now drawn from the interface model; no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.

owes: a changed default — the web's header, `⋮` panels, lists' and articles' action bars, row menu and Settings index are now drawn from the interface model: the markup and classes are the ones the pages drew, but the panel now marks the entry of the page on screen or its nearest ancestor (an article lights its list's entry, an instrument page *Watchlist*), a space in a search link's query is written `+`, and the sweeps' forms carry their arguments in the table's order; no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.

owes: SyncDesk — `engine/1` further gains, additions only, `ui.screen{destination, params?}` (the frame of a screen: title, back path and its title, layout, header count and note, banner, search, and the `⋮`, header and action-bar commands; `-32004`, `-32016`, `-32018`) and `ui.act{action, args}` (runs an action's SPEC-141 method, answers `{banner?, navigate?, refresh}`); `feed.markScope` takes optional `limit`, `sort`, `showRead` (the sweep of the first rows of an open view); vocabulary `1` also holds `Screen`, `Command` (with `group`, `selected`, `header`), `Target.external`, `SearchBox`, `Banner.link`; `ui.act` answers `-32601` for `feeds.readAbove` (a row's menu arrives with the bodies) and `-32602` for a category or search scope the engine does not mark; no migration, rollback safe.

owes: SyncDesk — `engine/1` gains, additions only, `hello.uiModel` (the vocabulary's version, `1`), the method `ui.pane{current?}` (the panel as data: account, apps with their coloured icons, the active app's destinations and per-person rows, `+ Add`, the footer's sync dots and the confirmed sign-out) and the notification `ui.changed{pane, destinations}` after `replica.changed`, `status.changed` and `session.changed`; vocabulary `1` is the panel's (`Pane`, `AppEntry`, `PaneEntry`, `Text`, the icon tokens incl. `app:<slug>`, `media:<key>` and `placeholder`); the app's switcher `value` is not carried yet; nothing changes for a client that does not call `ui.pane`; no migration, rollback safe.

owes: none — the new `:ui-model` module (the interface as data: vocabulary, icon tokens, destination catalogue, action table, the model's five-locale string catalogue) is on `:hub`'s and the engine's classpath and drawn by nothing yet; the web draws its icons and its panel strings from the same tokens and keys as before; the engine zip gains `synchub-engine/ui-strings/<locale>.json` (five flat key → text files, for SyncDesk's next re-pin); no migration, no configuration key, no wire change, `engine/1` unchanged, rollback safe.

owes: SyncDesk — `hello.uiModel` is now `2` (additions only): the model carries the bodies of *Settings*, *Interface*, *Synchronisation* and *About*, and SyncDesk draws what they add: the blocks `paragraph`, `notice` (with its reload hint), `hero`, `preformatted` and `link`; a `section` that is collapsible and has an `id`, a `note` and an `attention`; the `list` rows `menu` and `app` (a list's `heading` and `footer`); a `keyValue` entry's `attention` and `hint`; a `table` text cell's `detail` and `code`; a `fieldGroup` without a legend; a `choice` field's `icon` and `change`; and the text kind `duration`. `ui.screen` still answers those four screens without a body until the engine fills their facts. The web draws the four pages from the model's body: the markup and classes are the ones the pages drew, except that a failed update check's reason and an out-of-memory exit now draw their label and value both in the attention tone, and the reason's token is no longer in `code`; the strings those pages use moved to the model's catalogue, unchanged for a reader; no migration, rollback safe.

owes: SyncDesk — `hello.uiModel` is now `3` (additions only): the model carries the bodies of *Account*, its second-factor page, *Devices* and *App backups*, and SyncDesk draws what they add: the blocks `statusCard`, `qr` (it carries the `text` it encodes, replacing vocabulary 2's `pngBase64`, which no destination emitted; each renderer draws the picture) and `once`; a `table` `command` cell (with its yes/no confirmation) and `link` cell, and a table with no column headings; a text cell's `warning` and `strong`; an `emptyState`'s `command`; a `fieldGroup` of `text` (with `autocomplete`, `numeric` and `hidden`) and `password` (with `autocomplete` and `minLength`) fields, submitted with the group's command; and the `backups` destination's params `app` and `download` (a download is a read). `ui.screen` still answers those four screens without a body until the engine fills their facts. The web draws the four pages from the model's body: the markup and classes are the ones the pages drew, except that each titled group is now a section drawn as *About*'s are, the first-run *Devices* page carries its *Pair a device* button in the empty state (the `#pair-device` anchor is gone), *Pair a device* and *Turn on* are tonal where they were filled, *Regenerate recovery codes* is filled where it was tonal, and an app backup's size reads with a point in every locale; the strings those pages use moved to the model's catalogue, unchanged for a reader; no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.

owes: SyncDesk — `hello.uiModel` is now `4` (additions only): the model carries the bodies of *Apps* and its off confirmation, *Users*, one person's page and the new account, *Hub backup* and its restore view, *Home automation* and the *MQTT sync* page, and SyncDesk draws what they add: the rows `appSwitch`, `user` and `sensor`; the blocks `card` and `form` (several field sets submitted by the first command, a later command naming another action submitting the same fields there, a set's own commands each a small form of its own, and a `note` bound to the commands); a paragraph's `code`; a notice's `live` and `dot`; a status card's `hint`, `link`, `links`, `id` and `vivid`; an empty state's `links`; a `keyValue` entry's `code`; the fields `toggle` (with `onValue`), `multiChoice` (options with a hint, `implied` options and their note), `file` (with `accept`) and `note`, a field's `hint`, a text field's `inputType`, `required`, `pattern`, `maxLength`, `placeholder` and `inline`, a password's `required`; a screen's `refresh` (the broker page reading itself again); and the params `name` of `settings.backupRestore` and `test`, `wait` of `settings.broker`. `ui.screen` still answers those screens without a body until the engine fills their facts. The web draws the pages from the model's body: the markup and classes are the ones the pages drew, except that a failed update check's reason token is back in `code` (vocabulary 2 had dropped it), *Confirm* on an app's off view, *Take a snapshot now*, *Store it in the hub* and a certificate's *Confirm* are tonal buttons in their own form, a person's second factor is a section where it was a field set, the snapshot list has no heading row and puts *Download*, *Restore…* and *Delete* each in a cell of its own, an unwritable snapshot folder's dot is the failing one, and a field's hint is named `<field>-hint`; the strings those pages use moved to the model's catalogue, unchanged for a reader; no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.

owes: SyncDesk — `hello.uiModel` is now `5` (additions only) and `engine/1` gains, additions only, `ui.page{destination, params?, block, cursor?}` (the next rows of a `list` block, `{rows, more?}`; `-32004` for an unknown destination or block, and for every destination while the engine fills no body); the model carries the bodies of the notes (the board and a label's, the archive, the trash, the labels, the search, an unreadable record and the settings), and SyncDesk draws what they add: the rows `note` (with its `editor` drawn in the card's place, its `highlight` and its own commands) and `label`; the blocks `noteEditor` (title, body or items, the Markdown preview as SPEC-134's tree, labels and the ones it could take, attachments, the menu with its colour group and its confirmations, the banner of the last save; each field saving on its own), `region`, `searchForm` and `chips`; a list's `display` (`grid` or `list`); an empty state's `icon`; and a `richText` node's `href`, the tree now emitted. The notes' destinations take `edit` and `closing`, the search `scope` too. `ui.screen` still answers those screens without a body until the engine fills their facts. The web draws the notes from the model's body: the cards, the editor, its saves and fragments keep their markup and htmx, except that *New note* is a tonal button in an actions row, the empty archive, trash, labels and search carry the information mark, *Empty trash* asks with the two-button confirmation, a new label's field has its label, the settings are two choice rows, an unreadable record is an empty state with the warning mark, and an attachment's size reads with a point in every locale; the strings those pages use moved to the model's catalogue, unchanged for a reader; no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.

owes: SyncDesk — `hello.uiModel` is now `6` (additions only): the model carries the bodies of the weather (the board, a city's page and one day, the places, the accuracy, a city's sensor and the settings), and SyncDesk draws what they add: the block `forecast` in its views `band`, `header`, `hours`, `strip`, `now`, `week`, `fortnight` and `day` (each day and hour as numbers, a condition token with its words, the alerts it raises), the blocks `settingForm` (one setting on its card, its notices) and `heading`; the rows `place`, `candidate` and `sensorPick`; the charts `dayChart` and `accuracy` (series with gaps, `alt` and `legend`); a notice's `link` and `after`; a card's `heading`; a region's `style` (`place`, `grid`, the sensor page's columns); an inline `fieldGroup`; a form's `primary` and a field set's `collapsed` and `notes`; an empty state's `more` and `children`; a link's `prefix` and `paragraph`; a number field's `placeholder` and a choice drawn as a list in a form; a table's end-aligned columns; and `weather.sensor`'s params `discover`, `hand` and `pick`. `ui.screen` still answers those screens without a body until the engine fills their facts. The web draws the weather from the model's body in the markup it had, except that the empty board's link to the settings follows its sentence instead of ending it, and a refused address is drawn with the error mark; the strings those pages use, and the address settings' own, moved to the model's catalogue, unchanged for a reader; no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.

owes: SyncDesk — `hello.uiModel` is now `7` (additions only): the model carries the bodies of the stocks (the board, an instrument, the alerts, the news and one headline, the watchlist editor, the statement import in its three states and the settings), and SyncDesk draws what they add: the rows `instrument` (a `Quote` of numbers, its notices, the line said instead of a price, its freshness), `newsItem`, `line` and `watchlist`; the blocks `instrument` (views `head` and `quote`), `figures` (`returns`, `holding`) and `bullets`; the chart `priceChart`; a `candidate`'s kind `icon`; a chips row's `label`; a list's `link`; a text field's `lines`; a choice drawn as `radio`; the text kind `amount` and the instant style `utc`; an action's `prefix.*` fields; and a headline's summary as SPEC-134's tree, read from the stored HTML. `ui.screen` still answers those screens without a body until the engine fills their facts. The web draws the stocks from the model's body in the markup it had, except that a headline's summary is drawn from its tree, and the import's review lists what it will do above its form, groups its fields in field sets and shows *Import* disabled where it had none to offer; the strings those pages use moved to the model's catalogue, unchanged for a reader; no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.

owes: SyncDesk — `hello.uiModel` is now `8` (additions only), and every destination's frame now carries a body: the model carries the reader's lists (timeline, unread, favourites, saved, a category, a feed, a search), an article read in full, the sources and the feeds' health, and the hub's overview and catalogue of apps, and SyncDesk draws what they add: the rows `article`, `divider` and `source`; the blocks `article` (its text as SPEC-134's tree, its neighbours) and `hearts`, and the `cardGrid` now emitted; a list's `more` cursor `<offset>:<composedAt>`; a table cell's `tone` and `token`; and a muted `keyValue` entry. `feeds.article` takes a `from` query param, the list the article was opened from. `ui.screen` still answers those screens without a body until the engine fills their facts. The web draws them from the model's body in the markup it had, except that an article's text is drawn from its tree rather than the stored HTML as is, and the overview's empty-state button is tonal; the strings those pages use moved to the model's catalogue, unchanged for a reader; no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.
